parameters.name: AnalyzeResult
parameters.description:
The analysis result. Valid values:

- **black**: abnormal process

- **white**: normal process

parameters.name: FirstTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the time range for the first detection, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: FirstTimeStart
parameters.description: The start of the time range for the first detection, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Md5
parameters.description: The MD5 value of the file.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The server name or IP address.

parameters.name: Sha256
parameters.description: The SHA-256 value of the file.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server to query.
